characters.name: Antonia
characters.description: Young woman of Murcia; daughter of Elvira Dalfa and central young female figure whose fate is pursued in the narrative.

characters.name: Donna Elvira Dalfa
characters.description: Mother of Antonia; widow returned from the Indies; lodges in Madrid and seeks protection for her daughter.

characters.name: Leonella
characters.description: Sister of Elvira; talkative aunt of Antonia who brings the family to Madrid.

characters.name: Don Lorenzo / Lorenzo de Medina
characters.description: Young cavalier; suitor of Antonia; nephew of the Duke de Medina; one of the principal male interlocutors.

characters.name: Don Christoval / Condé d’Ossorio
characters.description: Friend and companion to Lorenzo who courts Leonella; named as Condé d’Ossorio in the text.

characters.name: Don Raymond, Marquis de las Cisternas
characters.description: Marquis who figures as a principal suitor and relation; travels incognito as Alphonso d’Alvarada during part of the narrative.

characters.name: Duke de Medina
characters.description: Lorenzo’s uncle, a duke who figures in Lorenzo’s marriage negotiations.

characters.name: Cardinal-Duke of Lerma
characters.description: High church official consulted about ecclesiastical dispensations and orders; aids Raymond.

characters.name: Ambrosio
characters.description: Abbot of the Capuchins, famed orator called “the Man of Holiness,” whose conduct becomes central to the plot.

characters.name: Matilda de Villanegas / Rosario
characters.description: Young woman secretly admitted to the monastery disguised as a male novice; known in the convent as Rosario until revealed as Matilda.

characters.name: Father Pablos
characters.description: Monastery surgeon and physician who attends Ambrosio and others.

characters.name: Mother St. Agatha (Prioress of St. Clare)
characters.description: Domina / Prioress of St. Clare’s Convent who presides over the nuns and whose severity drives key events.

characters.name: Mother St. Ursula
characters.description: Nun of St. Clare who becomes an accuser and reveals the secret of Agnes’s death.

characters.name: Agnes
characters.description: Donna Agnes, Lorenzo’s sister; novice at St. Clare whose fate (death) catalyses much of the plot.

characters.name: Dame Cunegonda
characters.description: Agnes’s governess / duenna; figures in secret-keeping and plot incidents.

characters.name: Dame Jacintha (Jacintha Zuniga)
characters.description: Antonia’s landlady and hostess in Madrid; assists and later reports mysterious events.

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: Antonia’s waiting-woman (maid) and constant attendant; vigilant and protective.

characters.name: Mother Camilla
characters.description: Nun at St. Clare who pleads for moderation in Agnes’s punishment.

characters.name: Sister Helena
characters.description: A nun mentioned among the community; vocal about terrors of the sepulchre.

characters.name: Sister Rachael
characters.description: A nun mentioned in the procession and listening at the grate.

characters.name: Violante
characters.description: Named nun accused as accomplice in St. Ursula’s accusation.

characters.name: Alix
characters.description: Named nun accused as accomplice in St. Ursula’s accusation.

characters.name: Mariana
characters.description: Named nun accused as accomplice in St. Ursula’s accusation.

characters.name: Virginia de Villa-Franca
characters.description: Young pensioner of St. Clare who represents St. Clare in the procession and takes refuge in the sepulchre.

characters.name: Baron Lindenberg
characters.description: German baron whose household intersects Alphonso/Don Raymond during travels.

characters.name: Baroness Lindenberg
characters.description: Baron Lindenberg’s wife who is rescued in the robbery episode and later hospitable to Alphonso.

characters.name: Baptiste
characters.description: Wood-cutter who conspires in an attempted robbery of a Spanish traveller; head of the robber household.

characters.name: Marguerite
characters.description: Wife of Baptiste who is involuntarily embroiled in the robberies; mother of two sons.

characters.name: Jacques
characters.description: Eldest son of Baptiste; involved with the robber band.

characters.name: Robert
characters.description: Second son of Baptiste who participates in robber band actions.

characters.name: Claude
characters.description: Postillion (driver) involved in the Woodman/robber episode.

characters.name: Stephano
characters.description: Servant of Alphonso/Don Raymond who is slain by robbers in a raid.

characters.name: Lucas
characters.description: French servant of Don Raymond who accompanies him on travels.

characters.name: Theodore
characters.description: Youth (page) who follows Alphonso/Don Raymond loyally and aids in many stratagems.

characters.name: Conrad
characters.description: Porter of Lindenberg Castle, a minor local character in that subplot.

characters.name: Beatrice de las Cisternas (the Bleeding Nun)
characters.description: Historic ancestor of the las Cisternas family; the ‘Bleeding Nun’ apparition and haunted figure at Lindenberg.

characters.name: Otto von Lindenberg
characters.description: Otto, brother of the Baron of Lindenberg; central to the murder of Beatrice in the castle legend.

characters.name: Durandarte
characters.description: Character in the included ballad "Durandarte and Belerma" (ballad figure).

characters.name: Belerma
characters.description: Female figure in the ballad “Durandarte and Belerma” included in the text.

characters.name: Montesinos
characters.description: Character (cousin) in the Durandarte ballad.

characters.name: The Gypsy
characters.description: Street prophetess/fortune-teller who sings a song and reads palms in Madrid.

characters.name: The Water-King
characters.description: Figure in an included Danish fragment/ballad recited in the narrative.

characters.name: Lorenzo
characters.description: Young nobleman (nephew of the Duke de Medina); leads rescue in the vaults and suitor to Virginia.

characters.name: Virginia
characters.description: Niece of the Duke de Medina; compassionate young woman who tends the rescued captive and later marries Lorenzo.

characters.name: Helena
characters.description: One of the nuns present in the vaults who relates the legend of the statue and warns Lorenzo.

characters.name: The Nuns (of St. Clare’s vault)
characters.description: Group of nuns present in the vaults and involved in events surrounding the statue, the rescue, and Agnes’s confinement.

characters.name: St. Clare (Statue)
characters.description: The statue/shrine of St. Clare in the vaults whose groans and concealed mechanism figure in the mystery.

characters.name: Agnes de Medina
characters.description: Lorenzo’s sister; formerly believed dead and later revealed as the captive rescued from the dungeon (central to the ‘History of Agnes de Medina’).

characters.name: Antonia
characters.description: Young woman drugged, placed in a vault and later raped and murdered in the Sepulchre; object of Ambrosio’s assault and Lorenzo’s mourning.

characters.name: Ambrosio
characters.description: A friar/Abbot whose designs result in rape, murder and eventual fall into sorcery and doom.

characters.name: Matilda
characters.description: Woman in the guise of a novice; accomplice to Ambrosio, versed in sorcery, later convicted and sentenced to the Auto da Fe.

characters.name: Don Ramirez
characters.description: Nobleman and leader of archers who assists Lorenzo in the vault searches and apprehension of culprits.

characters.name: Duke de Medina
characters.description: Nobleman, Lorenzo’s uncle, who aids the nuns and encourages Lorenzo’s recovery and marriage prospects.

characters.name: Don Raymond
characters.description: Nobleman in love with Agnes; later her husband (also called Raymond).

characters.name: Marquis de Villa-Franca
characters.description: Virginia’s father, concerned for his daughter’s safety and supportive of marriages arranged for advantage and security.

characters.name: Marchioness de Villa-Franca
characters.description: Virginia’s mother, who participates in nursing and social arrangements around Lorenzo and Virginia.

characters.name: Theodore
characters.description: Retainer/servant of Lorenzo who accompanies and rejoices at his master’s marriage.

characters.name: Camilla
characters.description: Nun who attends Agnes in the dungeon, brings her food daily and later becomes ill and dies in the convent fire.

characters.name: Mariana
characters.description: Nun who participates in Agnes’s condemnation and confinement to the dungeon.

characters.name: Alix
characters.description: Nun who assists in Agnes’s punishment and confinement.

characters.name: Violante
characters.description: Nun who assists the Prioress and takes part in Agnes’s sentencing and confinement.

characters.name: The Prioress / the Domina
characters.description: Superior of St. Clare’s Convent (referred to as Domina/Prioress) who orders Agnes’s apparent burial and secret confinement; later falls victim to the mob.

characters.name: Mother St. Ursula
characters.description: Nun who aids Agnes; identified as Mother St. Ursula and involved in later appointments (helps secure Agnes’s release).

characters.name: Camilla’s replacement (Lay-Sister)
characters.description: Unnamed lay-sister appointed to nurse during Camilla’s illness (consistently identified but unnamed).

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: Woman associated with Antonia (warns her); later allowed to return to Cuba and rewarded.

characters.name: Elvira
characters.description: Woman murdered earlier by Ambrosio; her ghost and memory appear in Ambrosio’s remorse and visions.

characters.name: Leonella
characters.description: Woman who, with Jacintha, rendered services to Elvira and receives thanks and presents from nobles.

characters.name: Jacintha
characters.description: Companion of Leonella who aided Elvira and is rewarded later.

characters.name: Bertha
characters.description: One of Agnes’s convent acquaintances later appointed to a charge in the Ladies of Charity.

characters.name: Cornelia
characters.description: One of Agnes’s convent acquaintances later appointed to a charge in the Ladies of Charity.

characters.name: Grand Inquisitor
characters.description: Head official of the Inquisition who presides over Ambrosio’s trial.

characters.name: Secretary (of the Inquisition)
characters.description: Clerk/secretary present at Ambrosio’s trial who records proceedings.

characters.name: Gaoler
characters.description: Prison gaoler who escorts Ambrosio and reports his disappearance; unnamed but consistently identified.

characters.name: The Archers
characters.description: Group of archers who search the vaults, protect the nuns, pursue fugitives and assist Don Ramirez and Lorenzo.

characters.name: Officer (unnamed)
characters.description: Single officer who appears in the Hall of Trial to escort Matilda and accompany proceedings; consistently identified but unnamed.
